name: Trouble in Paradise
source:
The Love Council is in trouble, for a destiny they created had been defied by their subjects. Two souls that were fated to be together ended up with their bonds cut and their hearts broken. Aphrodite, as the head of the council had to take matter into her own hands as her underlings discuss what's wrong with the couple they have set together. 

Would it be better if the Love Council brought the former couple back together and restored the balance of the world, or let them mend their broken hearts on their own?

[Edited from [url=https://chaiyaproject.itch.io/trouble-in-paradise]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
爱情委员会遇到了麻烦，因为他们创造的命运遭到了他们的臣民的反抗。两个注定要在一起的灵魂，最终却断了羁绊，心也碎了。阿佛洛狄忒，作为议会的首脑，她的下属们正在讨论他们所安排的这对夫妇出了什么问题，她必须亲自处理此事。

爱情委员会让这对前夫妻重归于好，恢复世界的平衡，还是让他们自己修复破碎的心会更好？

[编辑自[url=https://chaiyaproject.itch.io/trouble-in-paradise]itch.io[/url]]
